column1: # Authored Chinese translations for commonly used DFHack help; command names, parameters, and key names remain literal.
DFHack help: In-game DFHack command launcher with integrated help.
column2: 游戏内 DFHack 命令启动器，内置帮助信息。

column1: DFHack help: This tool is the primary GUI interface for running DFHack commands. You can open it from any screen with the ` hotkey. Tap ` again (or hit "Esc") to close. Users with keyboard layouts that make the ` key difficult (or impossible) to press can use the alternate hotkey of "Ctrl""Shift""D".
column2: 这是运行 DFHack 命令的主要图形界面。在任何界面按 ` 即可打开，再按一次 ` 或按 Esc 即可关闭。如果键盘布局不便输入 `，也可以使用 Ctrl+Shift+D。

column1: DFHack help: Open the launcher dialog with a blank initial commandline.
column2: 打开启动器，命令输入框初始为空。

column1: DFHack help: Open the launcher dialog in minimal mode with a blank initial commandline.
column2: 以精简模式打开启动器，命令输入框初始为空。

column1: DFHack help: Open the launcher dialog with the edit area pre-populated with the given command, ready for modification or running. Tools related to prospect will appear in the autocomplete list, and help text for "prospect" will be displayed in the lower panel.
column2: 打开启动器，并将给定命令填入输入框，便于修改或运行。右侧自动补全列表会显示与 prospect 相关的工具，下方面板会显示 prospect 的帮助。

column1: DFHack help: Editing and running commands
column2: 编辑和运行命令

column1: DFHack help: Editing and running commands ----------------------------
column2: 编辑和运行命令

column1: DFHack help: Enter the command you want to run by typing its name. If you want to start over, "Ctrl""X" will clear the line. When you are happy with the command, hit "Enter" or click on the "run" button to run it. Any output from the command will appear in the lower panel after you run it. If you want to run the command but close the dialog immediately so you can get back to the game, hold down the "Shift" key and click on the "run" button instead. The dialog also closes automatically if you run a command that brings up a new GUI screen. In any case, the command output will also be written to the DFHack terminal console (the separate window that comes up when you start DF) if you need to find it later.
column2: 输入要运行的命令名称。按 Ctrl+X 可清空输入框，重新输入。输入完成后，按 Enter 或点击运行按钮；命令输出会显示在下方面板。如果希望运行后立即关闭启动器并返回游戏，可按住 Shift 再点击运行按钮。运行会打开新图形界面的命令时，启动器也会自动关闭。命令输出同时写入 DFHack 终端控制台，也就是启动 DF 时出现的独立窗口，便于之后查阅。

column1: DFHack help: If the game was unpaused when you started gui/launcher, you can toggle pause by hit the spacebar once or twice. If you are already typing a command, the first space will go into the edit box for your commandline. If the commandline is empty or already has a space just before the cursor, the space key will be passed through to the game to affect the pause button. If the game was paused when you started gui/launcher, then this behavior is disabled to prevent accidental unpausing.
column2: 如果打开 gui/launcher 时游戏仍在运行，按一次或两次 Space 可切换暂停状态。正在输入命令时，第一个空格会输入到命令框中；命令框为空，或光标前已有空格时，Space 会传递给游戏，用于切换暂停。如果打开启动器时游戏已经暂停，则禁用此功能，以免意外恢复游戏运行。

column1: DFHack help: If your keyboard layout makes any key impossible to type (such as "[" and "]" on German QWERTZ keyboards), use "Ctrl""Shift""K" to bring up the on-screen keyboard. You can "type" the text you need by clicking on the characters with the mouse and then clicking the "Enter" button to send the text to the launcher editor.
column2: 如果键盘布局无法输入某些字符，例如德语 QWERTZ 键盘上的 [ 和 ]，可按 Ctrl+Shift+K 打开屏幕键盘。用鼠标点击所需字符，再点击 Enter 按钮，即可将文字送入启动器的命令输入框。

column1: DFHack help: Autocomplete
column2: 自动补全

column1: DFHack help: Autocomplete ------------
column2: 自动补全

column1: DFHack help: As you type, autocomplete options for DFHack commands appear in the right column. You can restrict which commands are shown in the autocomplete list by setting the tag filter with "Ctrl""W" or by clicking on the "Tags" button. If the first word of what you've typed matches a valid command, then the autocomplete options switch to showing commands that have similar functionality to the one that you've typed. Click on an autocomplete list option to select it or cycle through them with "Tab" and "Shift""Tab". You can run a command quickly without parameters by double-clicking on the tool name in the list. Holding down shift while you double-click allows you to run the command and close gui/launcher at the same time.
column2: 输入时，右侧会显示 DFHack 命令的自动补全候选项。按 Ctrl+W 或点击标签按钮可设置标签筛选，限制显示的命令。如果输入的第一个词已是有效命令，候选列表会改为显示功能相近的命令。点击候选项可选中它，也可按 Tab 或 Shift+Tab 循环选择。双击列表中的工具名称，可立即以无参数方式运行；按住 Shift 双击，则会在运行后同时关闭 gui/launcher。

column1: DFHack help: Context-sensitive help and command output
column2: 上下文帮助与命令输出

column1: DFHack help: Context-sensitive help and command output -----------------------------------------
column2: 上下文帮助与命令输出

column1: DFHack help: When you start "gui/launcher" without parameters, it shows some useful information in the lower panel about how to get started with DFHack.
column2: 不带参数启动 gui/launcher 时，下方面板会显示 DFHack 入门说明。

column1: DFHack help: Once you have typed (or autocompleted) a word that matches a valid command, the lower panel shows the help for that command, including usage instructions and examples. You can scroll the help text with the mouse wheel or with "PgUp" and "PgDn". You can also scroll line by line with "Shift""Up" and "Shift""Down".
column2: 输入或自动补全出有效命令后，下方面板会显示该命令的帮助，包括用法和示例。可用鼠标滚轮、PgUp 或 PgDn 滚动帮助文字，也可用 Shift+Up 或 Shift+Down 逐行滚动。

column1: DFHack help: Once you run a command, the lower panel will switch to command output mode, where you can see any text the command printed to the screen. If you want to see more help text as you browse further commands, you can switch the lower panel back to help mode with "Ctrl""T". The output text is kept for all the commands you run while the launcher window is open (up to 256KB of text), but only the most recent 32KB of text is saved if you dismiss the launcher window and bring it back up. Command output is also printed to the external DFHack console (the one you can show with show on Windows) or the parent terminal on Unix-based systems if you need a longer history of the output.
column2: 运行命令后，下方面板会切换到输出模式，显示命令打印的文字。继续浏览其他命令时，可按 Ctrl+T 切回帮助模式。启动器打开期间会保留各命令的输出，最多 256KB；关闭并重新打开后，仅保留最近 32KB。若需查阅更早的输出，可查看外部 DFHack 控制台，Windows 下可用 show 命令显示该窗口；Unix 系统则输出到启动 DFHack 的终端。

column1: DFHack help: You can run the clear command or click the "Clear output" button to clear the output scrollback buffer.
column2: 运行 clear 命令或点击清空输出按钮，可清除输出面板的历史内容。

column1: DFHack help: Command history
column2: 命令历史

column1: DFHack help: Command history ---------------
column2: 命令历史

column1: DFHack help: "gui/launcher" keeps a history of commands you have run to let you quickly run those commands again. You can scroll through your command history with the "Up" and "Down" arrow keys. You can also search your history for something specific with the "Alt""S" hotkey. When you hit "Alt""S", start typing to search your history for a match. To find the next match for what you've already typed, hit "Alt""S" again. You can run the matched command immediately with "Enter", or hit "Esc" to edit the command before running it.
column2: gui/launcher 会记录运行过的命令，便于再次运行。按 Up 或 Down 可浏览命令历史。按 Alt+S 后输入文字，可搜索匹配的历史命令；再次按 Alt+S 可查找下一个匹配项。按 Enter 可立即运行匹配的命令，按 Esc 则可先编辑再运行。

column1: DFHack help: Default tag filters
column2: 默认标签筛选

column1: DFHack help: Default tag filters -------------------
column2: 默认标签筛选

column1: DFHack help: By default, commands intended for developers and modders are filtered out of the autocomplete list. This includes any tools tagged with "unavailable". If you have "mortal mode" enabled in the gui/control-panel preferences, any tools with the "armok" tag are filtered out as well.
column2: 默认情况下，自动补全列表会隐藏面向开发者和模组作者的命令，包括带 unavailable 标签的工具。如果在 gui/control-panel 的偏好设置中启用了凡人模式，带 armok 标签的工具也会隐藏。

column1: DFHack help: You can toggle this default filtering by hitting "Ctrl""D" to switch into "Dev mode" at any time. You can also adjust your command filters in the "Tags" filter list.
column2: 随时按 Ctrl+D 切换开发者模式，即可切换默认筛选。也可在标签筛选列表中调整命令筛选条件。

column1: DFHack help: Configure DFHack and manage active DFHack tools.
column2: 配置 DFHack 并管理已启用的 DFHack 工具。

column1: DFHack help: The DFHack control panel allows you to quickly see and change what DFHack tools are enabled, which tools will run when you start a new fort, which UI overlays are enabled, and how global DFHack configuration options are set. It also provides convenient links to relevant help pages and GUI configuration frontends (where available). The control panel has several sections that you can access by clicking on the tabs at the top of the window. Each tab has a search filter so you can quickly find the tools and options that you're looking for.
column2: DFHack 控制面板可查看和更改已启用的工具、新建要塞时自动运行的工具、已启用的界面叠加组件，以及 DFHack 的全局配置。它还提供相关帮助页面和图形配置界面的快捷入口。点击窗口顶部的标签页可进入各个部分；每页都提供搜索筛选，便于查找工具和选项。

column1: DFHack help: The tabs can also be navigated with the keyboard, with the "Ctrl""T" and "Ctrl""Y" hotkeys. These are the default hotkeys for navigating DFHack tab bars.
column2: 也可按 Ctrl+T 或 Ctrl+Y 切换标签页。这是 DFHack 标签栏的默认切换快捷键。

column1: DFHack help: The "Automation", "Bug Fixes", and "Gameplay" tabs
column2: 自动化、错误修复与游戏功能标签页

column1: DFHack help: The "Automation", "Bug Fixes", and "Gameplay" tabs --------------------------------------------------
column2: 自动化、错误修复与游戏功能标签页

column1: DFHack help: These three tabs provide access to the three main subcategories of DFHack tools. In general, you'll probably want to start with only the "Bugfix" tools enabled. As you become more comfortable with vanilla systems, and some of them start to become less fun and more toilsome, you can enable more of the "Automation" tools to manage them for you. Finally, you can examine the tools on the "Gameplay" tab and enable whatever you think sounds like fun :).
column2: 这三页包含 DFHack 工具的三个主要类别。刚开始使用时，可以先只启用错误修复工具。熟悉原版系统后，如果某些操作变得繁琐，可逐步启用自动化工具代为管理。最后，可以浏览游戏功能页，启用感兴趣的工具。

column1: DFHack help: Under each of these tabs, there are two subtabs: "Enabled" and "Autostart". The subtabs can be navigated with the keyboard, using the "Ctrl""N" and "Ctrl""M" hotkeys.
column2: 每个标签页都有已启用和自动启动两个子页，可按 Ctrl+N 或 Ctrl+M 切换。

column1: DFHack help: The "Enabled" subtab
column2: 已启用子页

column1: DFHack help: The "Enabled" subtab ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
column2: 已启用子页

column1: DFHack help: The "Enabled" tab allows you to toggle which tools are enabled right now. You can select the tool in the list to see a short description at the bottom. Hit "Enter", double click on the tool name, or click on the toggle on the far left to enable or disable that tool.
column2: 已启用页用于控制当前启用的工具。在列表中选择工具后，底部会显示简短说明。按 Enter、双击工具名称或点击最左侧的开关，即可启用或禁用该工具。

column1: DFHack help: Note that before a fort is loaded, there will be very few tools listed here. Come back when a fort is loaded to see much more.
column2: 尚未载入要塞时，这里只会显示少量工具；载入要塞后，可用工具会明显增多。

column1: DFHack help: Once tools are enabled, they will save their state with your fort and automatically re-enable themselves when you load that same fort again.
column2: 启用状态会随要塞存档保存。再次载入同一要塞时，这些工具会自动重新启用。

column1: DFHack help: You can hit "Ctrl""H" or click on the help icon to show the help page for the selected tool in gui/launcher. You can also use this as shortcut to run custom commandline commands to configure that tool manually. If the tool has an associated GUI config screen, a gear icon will also appear next to the help icon. Hit "Ctrl""G", click on the gear icon, or Shift-double click the tool name to launch the relevant configuration interface.
column2: 按 Ctrl+H 或点击帮助图标，可在 gui/launcher 中打开所选工具的帮助，也可从这里输入自定义命令来手动配置工具。如果工具提供图形配置界面，帮助图标旁会显示齿轮图标。按 Ctrl+G、点击齿轮图标，或按住 Shift 双击工具名称，即可打开对应的配置界面。

column1: DFHack help: The "Autostart" subtab
column2: 自动启动子页

column1: DFHack help: The "Autostart" subtab ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
column2: 自动启动子页

column1: DFHack help: This subtab is organized similarly to the "Enabled" subtab, but instead of tools you can enable now, it shows the tools that you can configure DFHack to auto-enable or auto-run when you start the game or a new fort. You'll recognize many tools from the "Enabled" subtab here, but there are also useful one-time commands that you might want to run at the start of a fort, like ban-cooking all or (if you have "mortal mode" disabled in the "Preferences" tab) god-mode tools like light-aquifers-only.
column2: 此页的排列方式与已启用页相似，用于配置游戏启动或新建要塞时自动启用、自动运行的工具。除已启用页中的许多工具外，这里也包含适合在要塞创建时运行一次的命令，例如 ban-cooking all。如果在偏好设置中关闭了凡人模式，还可选择 light-aquifers-only 等神力工具。

column1: DFHack help: The "UI Overlays" tab
column2: 界面叠加组件标签页

column1: DFHack help: The "UI Overlays" tab ---------------------
column2: 界面叠加组件标签页

column1: DFHack help: DFHack overlays add information and additional functionality to the vanilla DF screens. For example, the popular DFHack Building Planner is an overlay named "buildingplan.planner" that appears when you are building something.
column2: DFHack 的叠加组件会在原版 DF 界面上添加信息和功能。例如，常用的建筑规划器就是名为 buildingplan.planner 的叠加组件，会在放置建筑时显示。

column1: DFHack help: The "Overlays" tab allows you to easily see which overlays are enabled, gives you a short description of what each one does, lets you toggle them on and off, and gives you links for the related help text (which is normally added at the bottom of the help page for the tool that provides the overlay). If you want to reposition any of the overlay widgets, hit "Ctrl""G" or click on the the hotkey hint to launch gui/overlay.
column2: 叠加组件页可查看各组件的启用状态和简短说明，切换开关，并打开相关帮助；帮助通常位于提供该组件的工具帮助页底部。按 Ctrl+G 或点击快捷键提示可打开 gui/overlay，调整组件在界面中的位置。

column1: DFHack help: The "Preferences" tab
column2: 偏好设置标签页

column1: DFHack help: The "Preferences" tab ---------------------
column2: 偏好设置标签页

column1: DFHack help: The "Preferences" tab allows you to change DFHack's internal settings and defaults, like whether DFHack's "mortal mode" is enabled -- hiding the god-mode tools from the UI, whether DFHack tools pause the game when they come up, or how long you can take between clicks and still have it count as a double-click. Click on the gear icon or hit "Enter" to toggle or edit the selected preference.
column2: 偏好设置页用于调整 DFHack 的内部设置和默认行为，例如是否启用凡人模式并隐藏神力工具、打开 DFHack 工具时是否暂停游戏，以及两次点击之间允许的双击间隔。点击齿轮图标或按 Enter，即可切换或编辑所选设置。

column1: DFHack help: Automatically manage dwarf labors.
column2: 自动管理矮人的劳动分配。

column1: DFHack help: The "autolabor" command runs the plugin's *legacy* engine, which writes the labor matrix directly and bypasses the work detail system. The same plugin also provides the labormanager command, a modern engine that works through the work detail system instead. A third *monitor* mode watches the job board and shows task starvation warnings without managing labors at all. Only one mode can be active at a time; "autolabor mode [legacy|modern|monitor]" or the overlay on the work details screen switches between them, and the selected mode persists across save/load.
column2: autolabor 命令运行插件的传统引擎，直接改写劳动分配表，绕过工作分工系统。同一插件还提供 labormanager 命令，它采用现代引擎，通过工作分工系统管理劳动。第三种监控模式只监视待办工作并提示长期无人执行的任务，不调整劳动分配。同一时间只能启用一种模式。可用 autolabor mode [legacy|modern|monitor] 或工作分工界面上的叠加面板切换，所选模式会随存档保存和恢复。

column1: DFHack help: Autolabor attempts to keep as many dwarves as possible busy while allowing dwarves to specialize in specific skills.
column2: Autolabor 尽量让更多矮人有事可做，同时允许他们专精于特定技能。

column1: DFHack help: Autolabor frequently checks how many jobs of each type are available and sets labors proportionally in order to get them all done quickly. Labors with equipment -- mining, hunting, and woodcutting -- which are abandoned if labors change mid-job, are handled slightly differently to minimize churn.
column2: Autolabor 会经常统计各类待办工作，按需求比例分配劳动，以尽快完成任务。采矿、狩猎和伐木需要装备；执行期间改变劳动分配会使任务中断，因此会采用稍有不同的分配方式，减少反复切换。

column1: DFHack help: Dwarves on active military duty or dwarves assigned to burrows are left untouched by autolabor.
column2: Autolabor 不会更改正在服役或已分配到活动区域的矮人的劳动设置。

column1: DFHack help: **This plugin is still being tested. Use at your own risk.**The algorithms that autolabor uses to choose labor assignments have *not* been updated for version 50 of Dwarf Fortress. There is no particular guarantee that the labor assignments autolabor is making are optimal, and it is entirely possible that the assignments it makes will lead to unforeseen consequences. You should monitor what your dwarves are doing, and more importantly not doing, when using autolabor.At this time there is no way to easily see what labors are being assigned to whom, as there is no longer any vanilla means for seeing the labor assignment table. Until manipulator is once again available, probably the best way to see what autolabor is doing is to use Dwarf Therapist. You can also increase autolabor's logging level using the debugfilter command (setting either "debug" or "trace" level for the "cycle" mode) but be warned that this may generate a large amount of console spam, especially in a large fort.When it is enabled in legacy mode, autolabor automatically disables the work detail system. You cannot use legacy autolabor and work details at the same time. The DFHack overlay panel on the work details screen (the same panel that provides the gui/settings-manager save/load buttons) shows the active mode and warns you when legacy mode is preventing changes on that screen from taking effect.Should you disable autolabor or switch to modern mode, the vanilla work detail system is automatically reenabled and all citizens' labors are recomputed from the work details.
column2: 此插件仍在测试中，使用风险自行承担。autolabor 的劳动分配算法尚未针对 Dwarf Fortress 50 版更新，不能保证分配最优，也可能产生意外后果。使用时应留意矮人正在执行哪些工作，尤其是哪些工作无人执行。原版目前已无法显示劳动分配表，因此不容易直接看出各项劳动分给了谁。在 manipulator 恢复可用之前，可用 Dwarf Therapist 查看分配情况。也可通过 debugfilter，将 cycle 模式的日志级别设为 debug 或 trace，以获得更多信息；但这可能产生大量控制台输出，尤其是在大型要塞中。传统模式的 autolabor 会自动禁用工作分工系统，两者不能同时使用。工作分工界面的 DFHack 叠加面板，也就是提供 gui/settings-manager 保存与载入按钮的面板，会显示当前模式，并在传统模式使界面更改无法生效时发出提示。禁用 autolabor 或切换到现代模式后，原版工作分工系统会自动恢复，并根据工作分工重新计算所有居民的劳动分配。

column1: DFHack help: Anything beyond this is optional - autolabor works well with the default settings. Once you have enabled it in a fortress, it stays enabled until you explicitly disable it, even if you save and reload your game.
column2: 其余设置均为可选；autolabor 的默认设置通常就能正常工作。在要塞中启用后，它会保持启用，保存并重新载入游戏也不会关闭，直到你明确禁用它。

column1: DFHack help: By default, each labor is assigned to between 1 and 200 dwarves (2-200 for mining). 33% of the workforce become haulers, who handle all hauling jobs as well as cleaning, pulling levers, recovering wounded, removing constructions, and filling ponds. Other jobs are automatically assigned as described above. Each of these settings can be adjusted.
column2: 默认每项劳动分配给 1 至 200 名矮人，采矿为 2 至 200 名。33% 的劳动力会成为搬运工，负责所有搬运，以及清洁、拉动杠杆、救助伤员、拆除建造物和给池塘注水。其他工作按上述方式自动分配。这些设置均可调整。

column1: DFHack help: Jobs are rarely assigned to nobles with responsibilities for meeting diplomats or merchants, never to the chief medical dwarf, and less often to the bookkeeper and manager.
column2: 负责接待外交官或商人的贵族很少会被分配工作；医疗主管不会被分配工作；记账员和经理也会较少承担其他工作。

column1: DFHack help: Hunting is never assigned without a butchery, and fishing is never assigned without a fishery.
column2: 没有屠宰作坊时不分配狩猎，没有鱼类加工坊时不分配捕鱼。

column1: DFHack help: For each labor, a preference order is calculated based on skill, excluding those who can't do the job. Dwarves who are masters of a skill are deprioritized for other skills. The labor is then added to the best <minimum> dwarves for that labor, then to additional dwarfs that meet any of these conditions:
column2: 对每项劳动，先排除无法执行的矮人，再按技能计算分配优先顺序。某项技能的专家在分配其他劳动时优先级会降低。先将该劳动分配给最合适的 <minimum> 名矮人，再根据下列任一条件增加人手：

column1: DFHack help: * The dwarf is idle and there are no idle dwarves assigned to this labor
column2: • 该矮人空闲，且已分配该劳动的矮人中无人空闲。

column1: DFHack help: * The dwarf has non-zero skill associated with the labor
column2: • 该矮人在相关技能上已有经验。

column1: DFHack help: * The labor is mining, hunting, or woodcutting and the dwarf currently has it enabled.
column2: • 该劳动为采矿、狩猎或伐木，且该矮人当前已启用它。

column1: DFHack help: We stop assigning dwarves when we reach the maximum allowed.
column2: 达到人数上限后，停止增加分配。

column1: DFHack help: Autolabor uses DFHack's debug functionality to display information about the changes it makes. The amount of information displayed can be controlled through appropriate use of the "debugfilter" command.
column2: Autolabor 使用 DFHack 的调试功能输出劳动分配更改的信息。可用 debugfilter 命令控制输出的详细程度。

column1: DFHack help: Keep at least 5 dwarves with mining enabled.
column2: 始终为至少 5 名矮人启用采矿。

column1: DFHack help: Keep exactly 1 dwarf with gem cutting enabled.
column2: 只为 1 名矮人启用宝石切割。

column1: DFHack help: Keep 1 dwarf with cooking enabled, selected only from the top 3.
column2: 只从烹饪技能最好的 3 名矮人中选择 1 名，启用烹饪。

column1: DFHack help: Have haulers feed and water wounded dwarves.
column2: 由搬运工为受伤矮人送食物和水。

column1: DFHack help: Turn off autolabor for wood cutting.
column2: 停止自动管理伐木劳动。

column1: DFHack help: Advanced usage
column2: 高级用法

column1: DFHack help: Advanced usage --------------
column2: 高级用法

column1: DFHack help: List current status of all labors. Use this command to see the IDs for all labors.
column2: 列出所有劳动的当前状态，并查看各劳动的 ID。

column1: DFHack help: Show basic status information.
column2: 显示基本状态信息。

column1: DFHack help: Set range of dwarves assigned to a labor, optionally specifying the size of the pool of most skilled dwarves that will ever be considered for this labor.
column2: 设置该劳动的分配人数范围；还可指定候选人才数量，仅从技能最好的这些矮人中分配该劳动。

column1: DFHack help: Set a labor to be handled by hauler dwarves.
column2: 将某项劳动交给搬运工执行。

column1: DFHack help: Turn off autolabor for a specific labor.
column2: 停止自动管理指定劳动。

column1: DFHack help: Return a labor (or all labors) to the default handling.
column2: 将指定劳动或所有劳动恢复为默认分配方式。

column1: DFHack help: Show or change which engine runs when the plugin is enabled. Monitor mode performs no labor management; it only watches the job board and reports starving job postings via the DFHack notification panel.
column2: 显示或更改插件启用时使用的引擎。监控模式不管理劳动，只监视待办工作，并通过 DFHack 通知面板提示长期无人执行的任务。

column1: DFHack help: See autolabor-artisans for a differently-tuned setup.
column2: 另一种侧重工匠专精的配置见 autolabor-artisans。

column1: DFHack help: Reveal the map.
column2: 揭示地图。

column1: DFHack help: Revert a revealed map to its unrevealed state.
column2: 将已揭示的地图恢复为原先未揭示的状态。

column1: DFHack help: Discard records about what was visible before revealing the map.
column2: 丢弃揭示地图之前的可见范围记录。

column1: DFHack help: Switch between reveal and unreveal.
column2: 在 reveal 与 unreveal 之间切换。

column1: DFHack help: Hide everything, then reveal tiles with a path to a unit.
column2: 先隐藏整张地图，再揭示可通过路径到达某单位的地块。

column1: DFHack help: This reveals all z-layers in fort and adventure mode. The effect persists until you run "unreveal".
column2: 在要塞模式和冒险模式中揭示所有高度层。效果会持续到运行 unreveal 为止。

column1: DFHack help: In graphics mode, solid tiles that are not adjacent to open space will not be rendered, but they can still be examined by hovering over them with the mouse. Switching to ASCII mode (in the game settings) will allow the display of the revealed solid tiles.
column2: 图形模式不会绘制未与开放空间相邻的实心地块，但仍可将鼠标移到其上查看信息。在游戏设置中切换为 ASCII 模式后，即可显示这些已揭示的实心地块。

column1: DFHack help: For a GUI that auto-restores the map when closed, see gui/reveal.
column2: 如需关闭后自动恢复地图的图形界面，请见 gui/reveal。

column1: DFHack help: Reveal the whole map. If "hell" is specified, also reveal HFS areas, but you are required to run "unreveal" before unpausing is allowed in order to prevent the demons (or treasures) from spawning. If you really want to unpause with secrets revealed, specify "demon" instead of "hell". Note that unpausing with secrets revealed may result in a flood of announcements about the revealed secrets!
column2: 揭示整张地图。指定 hell 时也会揭示 HFS 区域，但为避免生成恶魔或宝藏，必须先运行 unreveal 才能恢复游戏运行。如果确实要在秘密区域已揭示的情况下继续游戏，请使用 demon 代替 hell。注意，这可能产生大量关于已揭示秘密的公告！

column1: DFHack help: Reverts the effects of "reveal" if run immediately afterwards. If you have saved the fort in a revealed state and want to restore the map, use "revflood".
column2: 紧接 reveal 运行时，可撤销地图揭示效果。如果已经在地图揭示状态下保存要塞，应使用 revflood 恢复地图。

column1: DFHack help: Switches between "reveal" and "unreveal". Convenient to bind to a hotkey.
column2: 在 reveal 和 unreveal 之间切换，适合绑定快捷键。

column1: DFHack help: Discard info about what was visible before revealing the map. Only useful where (for example) you abandoned with the fort revealed and no longer need the saved map data when you load a new fort.
column2: 丢弃揭示地图之前的可见范围信息。仅适用于不再需要该记录的情况，例如在地图已揭示时放弃了要塞，随后载入新要塞。

column1: DFHack help: Hide everything, then reveal tiles with a path to the keyboard cursor (if enabled) or the selected unit (if a unit is selected) or else a random citizen. This allows repairing maps that you accidentally saved while they were revealed. Note that tiles behind constructed walls are also revealed as a workaround for Bug 1871.
column2: 先隐藏整张地图，再揭示可通过路径到达键盘光标的地块；未启用键盘光标时，使用选中的单位；也未选中单位时，使用一名随机居民。这可恢复误在地图已揭示状态下保存的地图。为绕过 Bug 1871，建造墙后方的地块也会被揭示。

column1: DFHack help: Caveats
column2: 注意事项

column1: DFHack help: Caveats -------
column2: 注意事项

column1: DFHack help: Sometimes, the map generates secret hollows adjacent to caverns in such a way that the ceiling of the hollow collapses on the first tick of the embark, leaving the hollow exposed to the caverns. In this case, the secret event will be triggered as soon as the cavern is discovered and that tile is unhidden. This would happen anyway even if you don't use reveal, but be aware that it is possible to trigger *some* events when you run reveal, even without the "hell" option.
column2: 有时地图会在地下洞穴旁生成秘密空腔，其顶板在定居后的第一个时间步就塌落，使空腔与洞穴连通。此时，一旦发现洞穴并揭示该地块，就会触发秘密事件。即使不使用 reveal，这种情况也会发生；因此，即使未指定 hell，运行 reveal 仍可能触发某些事件。

column1: DFHack help: When running "unreveal" to restore the map in adventure mode, the vision cone for the adventurer isn't fully restored until the adventurer takes a step.
column2: 冒险模式下运行 unreveal 恢复地图后，冒险者必须移动一步，视野范围才会完全恢复。

column1: DFHack help: Instantly gather or destroy items marked for dumping.
column2: 立即集中或销毁标记为倾倒的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Destroy items marked for dumping under the keyboard cursor.
column2: 销毁键盘光标所在位置标记为倾倒的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Destroy the selected item.
column2: 销毁选中的物品。

column1: DFHack help: This tool can instantly move all unforbidden items marked for dumping to the tile under the keyboard cursor. After moving the items, the dump flag is unset and the forbid flag is set, just as if it had been dumped normally. See gui/autodump for an interactive version of this tool.
column2: 此工具可立即将所有未禁用且标记为倾倒的物品移到键盘光标所在的地块。移动后会取消倾倒标记，并将物品标记为禁用，与正常倾倒的结果相同。交互式图形版本见 gui/autodump。

column1: DFHack help: The keyboard cursor can be placed on a floor tile or in the air. If in air, the items will be converted into projectiles and fall. Items cannot be dumped inside of walls.
column2: 键盘光标可放在地面或空中。目标在空中时，物品会转为抛射物并下落。无法将物品倾倒到墙体内部。

column1: DFHack help: "autodump-destroy-here" is an alias for "autodump destroy-here" and is intended for use as a keybinding.
column2: autodump-destroy-here 是 autodump destroy-here 的别名，便于绑定快捷键。

column1: DFHack help: "autodump-destroy-item" marks the currently viewed item for destruction. The pending destruction can be canceled if the command is run again before unpausing, or by running "autodump undestroy".
column2: autodump-destroy-item 将当前查看的物品标记为待销毁。在恢复游戏运行之前，再次运行该命令或运行 autodump undestroy 可取消销毁。

column1: DFHack help: Destroy instead of dumping. Doesn't require a cursor. Items held by units (e.g. equipped or in a carried container) are skipped, and the contents of destroyed containers are destroyed along with the container.
column2: 直接销毁物品，而非倾倒，无需光标。单位持有的物品会跳过，包括装备及随身容器中的物品；销毁容器时，其内部物品也会一并销毁。

column1: DFHack help: Destroy items under the cursor that are marked for dumping.
column2: 销毁光标所在位置标记为倾倒的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Revert pending destruction of items marked by "destroy", "destroy-here", or "autodump-destroy-item". Only works while the game is still paused; once a frame passes, the items may already be gone.
column2: 撤销由 destroy、destroy-here 或 autodump-destroy-item 标记的待执行销毁。仅在游戏仍暂停时有效；游戏运行一帧后，物品可能已被销毁。

column1: DFHack help: Only process items that are not hidden.
column2: 只处理未隐藏的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Only process hidden items.
column2: 只处理隐藏的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Only process forbidden items (default: only unforbidden).
column2: 只处理已禁用的物品；默认只处理未禁用的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Teleports unforbidden items marked for dumping to the cursor position.
column2: 将未禁用且标记为倾倒的物品瞬间移动到光标位置。

column1: DFHack help: Destroys all unforbidden items marked for dumping.
column2: 销毁所有未禁用且标记为倾倒的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Destroys all forbidden items marked for dumping, skipping unforbidden items.
column2: 销毁所有已禁用且标记为倾倒的物品，跳过未禁用物品。

column1: DFHack help: Destroys unforbidden items on the selected tile that are marked for dumping.
column2: 销毁所选地块上未禁用且标记为倾倒的物品。

column1: DFHack help: Destroys the item currently being viewed, or reverts its pending destruction.
column2: 销毁当前查看的物品，或撤销其待执行销毁。

column1: DFHack help: Reverts pending destruction of all marked items.
column2: 撤销所有已标记物品的待执行销毁。

column1: DFHack help: Provides commands that help you analyze natural resources.
column2: 提供分析自然资源的命令。

column1: DFHack help: Shows a summary of resources that exist on the map.
column2: 显示地图上的资源汇总。

column1: DFHack help: It can also calculate an estimate of resources available in the currently highlighted embark area.
column2: 还可估算当前选中定居区域内的可用资源。

column1: DFHack help: By default, only the visible part of the map is scanned. Include the "all" keyword if you want "prospect" to scan the whole map as if it were revealed. Use "hell" instead of "all" if you also want to see the Z range of HFS tubes in the 'features' report section.
column2: 默认只扫描地图中已可见的部分。添加 all 可让 prospect 扫描整张地图，包括尚未揭示的区域。如果还想在 features 报告部分看到 HFS 管道的高度范围，请用 hell 代替 all。

column1: DFHack help: Shows the entire report for the entire map.
column2: 显示整张地图的完整资源报告。

column1: DFHack help: Shows only the layers, ores, and other vein stone report sections, and includes information on HFS tubes (if run on a fortress map and not the pre-embark screen).
column2: 只显示岩层、矿石和其他矿脉石材部分；在要塞地图中运行时还会包含 HFS 管道信息，在定居前界面运行时则不包含。

column1: DFHack help: Show only information about ores for the pre-embark or fortress map report.
column2: 只显示定居前区域或要塞地图的矿石信息。

column1: DFHack help: Shows only the named comma-separated list of report sections. Report section names are: summary, liquids, layers, features, ores, gems, veins, shrubs, and trees. If run during pre-embark, only the layers, ores, gems, and veins report sections are available.
column2: 只显示指定的报告部分，多个名称用逗号分隔。可用名称为 summary（汇总）、liquids（液体）、layers（岩层）、features（地形特征）、ores（矿石）、gems（宝石）、veins（矿脉）、shrubs（灌木）和 trees（树木）。在定居前运行时，只有 layers、ores、gems 和 veins 可用。

column1: DFHack help: Includes material value in the output. Most useful for the 'gems' report section.
column2: 在输出中包含材料价值，尤其适用于 gems 宝石报告部分。

column1: DFHack help: Pre-embark estimate
column2: 定居前资源估算

column1: DFHack help: Pre-embark estimate -------------------
column2: 定居前资源估算

column1: DFHack help: If prospect is called during the embark selection screen, it displays an estimate of layer stone availability. If the "all" keyword is specified, it also estimates ores, gems, and vein material. The estimate covers all tiles of the embark rectangle.
column2: 在选择定居地点的界面运行 prospect，会估算各岩层的石材数量。指定 all 时，还会估算矿石、宝石和矿脉材料。估算范围覆盖定居矩形内的所有地块。

column1: DFHack help: The results of pre-embark prospect are an *estimate*, and can at best be expected to be somewhere within +/- 30% of the true amount; sometimes it does a lot worse. In particular, it is not clear how to precisely compute how many soil layers there will be in a given embark tile, so it can report a whole extra layer, or omit one that is actually present.
column2: 定居前的 prospect 结果只是估算值；即使较理想，也可能与实际数量相差约 ±30%，有时误差还会更大。尤其是无法精确计算某个定居地块中的土壤层数，因此可能多报一整层，也可能漏报实际存在的一层。

column1: DFHack help: Display help about a command or plugin.
column2: 显示命令或插件的帮助。

column1: DFHack help: Can also be invoked as "?" or "man" (short for "manual").
column2: 也可使用 ? 或 man，后者是 manual 的缩写。

column1: DFHack help: Both examples above will display the help text for the blueprint command.
column2: 以上两个示例都会显示 blueprint 命令的帮助。

column1: DFHack help: Some commands also take "help" or "?" as an option on their command line for the same effect -- e.g. "blueprint help".
column2: 某些命令也支持添加 help 或 ? 参数来显示帮助，例如 blueprint help。

column1: DFHack help: List the categories of DFHack tools or the tools with those tags.
column2: 列出 DFHack 工具的分类标签，或带指定标签的工具。

column1: DFHack help: DFHack tools are labeled with tags so you can find groups of related commands. This builtin command lists the tags that you can explore, or, if called with the name of a tag, lists the tools that have that tag.
column2: DFHack 工具通过标签分类，方便查找相关命令。此内置命令可列出所有标签；指定标签名称时，则列出带有该标签的工具。

column1: DFHack help: List the categories of DFHack tools and a description of those categories.
column2: 列出 DFHack 工具的分类及各分类的说明。

column1: DFHack help: List the tools that are tagged with the given tag.
column2: 列出带指定标签的工具。

column1: DFHack help: List the defined tags.
column2: 列出已定义的标签。

column1: DFHack help: List all the tools that have the "design" tag.
column2: 列出所有带 design 标签的工具。

column1: DFHack help: List available DFHack commands.
column2: 列出可用的 DFHack 命令。

column1: DFHack help: In order to group related commands, each command is associated with a list of tags. You can filter the listed commands by a tag or a substring of the command name. Can also be invoked as "dir".
column2: 每条命令都关联一组标签，用于归类相关命令。可按标签或命令名称中的部分文字筛选，也可使用 dir 调用此命令。

column1: DFHack help: Lists all available commands and the tags associated with them.
column2: 列出所有可用命令及其关联标签。

column1: DFHack help: Shows only commands that have the given tag. Use the tags command to see the list of available tags.
column2: 只显示带指定标签的命令。使用 tags 命令可查看可用标签。

column1: DFHack help: Shows commands that include the given string. E.g. "ls quick" will show all the commands with "quick" in their names. If the string is also the name of a tag, then it will be interpreted as a tag name.
column2: 显示名称包含指定文字的命令。例如，ls quick 会显示名称中带 quick 的所有命令。如果这段文字也是标签名称，则按标签筛选。

column1: DFHack help: List all commands that match the substring "quick".
column2: 列出名称包含 quick 的所有命令。

column1: DFHack help: List all commands with the "adventure" tag.
column2: 列出所有带 adventure 标签的命令。

column1: DFHack help: List all commands, including developer and modding commands, that match the substring "trigger".
column2: 列出名称包含 trigger 的所有命令，包括面向开发者和模组作者的命令。

column1: DFHack help: Don't print out the tags associated with each command.
column2: 不显示命令关联的标签。

column1: DFHack help: Include commands intended for developers and modders.
column2: 包含面向开发者和模组作者的命令。

column1: DFHack help: Exclude commands that match any of the given strings.
column2: 排除名称匹配任一指定文字的命令。
